prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the single frame of the HALCYON BULWARK boss main hull — the huge armoured slab that carries its core and shield plates.

Design identity to keep exactly — a massive rectangular armour slab, wider than tall (about 3:2), with chamfered corners: mid steel-blue armour field (#2e5082) built from bold vertical panel seams and recessed channels in deep blue (#1e3458), a lit pale-blue top edge ramp (#4a78b0 into #8ab8e8) as if lit from upper left, scattered cyan sensor lights (#38d8f8) set into the panels, and a cluster of small amber warning lights (#e8c048) in its lower-right field, all wrapped in a 1-px near-black outline (#0a1428). Chunky, industrial, unbreakable — heavy bolted plate armour with visible rivet rows.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 1 cell laid out as 1 ROW OF 1 (one single cell = the whole canvas) holding exactly ONE hull; the canvas IS one cell.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the full hull seen head-on: its broad face fills the cell. The subject lies within aspect 1.20:1 to 1.90:1.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×384 px. Produce EXACTLY 1 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: the hull sits at the exact centre of the canvas, sized to fill most of it while keeping at least 12 px of flat key to every edge.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge

notes:
bosses/bulwark-hull (1f 72×48 served; main hull behind the core, armour) — the 1 cells cropped to their measured subject boxes with the 6-px key border clamped inside each cell; single frame; the sheet state probe floor 0.4%. The design carries its own 1-px outline, so the outline pass is off.
